_readme: Edit this file to add or remove news sources. Each source is one RSS/Atom feed. Set "active": false to switch a source off without deleting it. Only headline, short snippet and link are ever stored. 'group' says which publishing organisation owns a feed, so two feeds from the same outlet never count as two independent sources.
